@copilot Reduce this PR's added testing to the existing AwsLambdaSqsMessageHandlerTest.processSpans() mixed-batch integration test. Preserve the production fix and all pre-existing tests. This is a user-directed reduction of coverage, not a request to expand it.

The user's goal is: "All I really want is basic integration test coverage for that shows these error types now being captured where they weren't before". This PR concerns Lambda SQS messaging telemetry, not database spans.

Keep the updated processSpans() assertions: the message whose handler returns false has status ERROR and error.type="_OTHER" on its process span and duration metric, while successful messages and the enclosing invocation remain successful. Keep the existing mixed-batch response assertions and counting semantics. That one public handleRequest invocation already exercises the production handler and the common instrumenter factory together; no separate helper or suppression matrix is needed.

Revert this PR's parameterization and added assertions in keyedEventSuppressesSelectedMessage to its original pre-PR single-case test. Do not delete that original test. Remove the newly introduced parameterized-test imports if they become unused. Keep the rest of the existing test suite unchanged.

Keep the production changes in TracingSqsMessageHandler and AwsLambdaSqsInstrumenterFactory unchanged. Keep this existing PR draft against main. Follow repository instructions, format changed files, and run the narrow relevant existing tests. Do not add unrelated cleanup, configuration, production changes, new PR work, or review requests.

replies.body: Restored the original single-case suppression test and kept the mixed-batch integration assertions unchanged. Focused test passed. Commit: `0dda0975`.

@copilot Update this existing PR directly with these two user-requested changes. Do not create a new result class or request a separate follow-up PR.

Use Boolean, rather than Void, as the response type for per-message SQS processing. Pass the handleMessage success/failure outcome directly to messageInstrumenter.end. Update the relevant instrumenter factory, response-dependent messaging getters/extractors, and customization API consistently. Keep the event/batch instrumenter response type Void. Handle any published protected-constructor API compatibility according to repository policy; do not use raw types or unsafe casts to feed Boolean values into existing Void extractors.

Use a SpanStatusExtractor to derive the per-message status from the response and exception, and an AttributesExtractor to record error.type="_OTHER" for a false response with no exception. Remove the MESSAGE_PROCESSING_SUCCESSFUL context key, withMessageProcessingOutcome helper, manual span-status mutation, and the comment explaining the Void/context workaround. Preserve the existing exception classification and recording, failed-item response contents, consumed-message counts, and successful enclosing invocation behavior. A successful message remains UNSET; a false response produces ERROR and error.type="_OTHER" on its process span and duration metric.

In AwsLambdaSqsMessageHandlerTest, replace the newly added hasStatusSatisfying(status -> status.hasCode(StatusCode.UNSET)) assertions with .hasStatus(StatusData.unset()). Use the corresponding direct .hasStatus(StatusData.error()) for the newly added ERROR assertion, with the appropriate StatusData import and removal of unused imports.

Relevant files are TracingSqsMessageHandler in instrumentation/aws-lambda/aws-lambda-events-3.11/library, AwsLambdaSqsInstrumenterFactory and the SQS messaging getters in instrumentation/aws-lambda/aws-lambda-events-common-2.2/library, and AwsLambdaSqsMessageHandlerTest. Keep the existing mixed-batch processSpans integration coverage and pre-existing tests; do not add a helper-test or suppression matrix or unrelated cleanup. Follow repository API/deprecation documentation requirements for any supported API change, apply formatting, and run the narrow relevant existing tests. Preserve this PR's draft state and base branch. Do not post replies to human comments, resolve review threads, or request a review.

@copilot Apply this user-approved test-only simplification directly to this existing Lambda SQS PR. Change only the metric assertions inside AwsLambdaSqsMessageHandlerTest.processSpans(), in instrumentation/aws-lambda/aws-lambda-events-3.11/library/src/test/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/awslambdaevents/v3_11/AwsLambdaSqsMessageHandlerTest.java. Do not create a separate follow-up PR.

For messaging.process.duration, retain the metric-name selection, histogram type, and unit "s". Assert exactly the expected point attribute key sets using point.hasAttributesSatisfying(attributes -> assertThat(attributes.asMap()).containsOnlyKeys(...)). One point must contain only MESSAGING_OPERATION_NAME, MESSAGING_SYSTEM, and MESSAGING_DESTINATION_NAME. The other must contain those three keys plus ERROR_TYPE. Do not repeat attribute values, including error.type="_OTHER", on the metric.

For messaging.client.consumed.messages, retain the metric-name selection and long-sum type, assert unit "{message}", and assert one point containing only MESSAGING_OPERATION_NAME, MESSAGING_SYSTEM, and MESSAGING_DESTINATION_NAME using the same exact-key assertion style.

Remove .hasCount(...), .hasSumGreaterThan(...), and .hasValue(2) from these processSpans metric assertions. This is an explicit user-directed reduction of assertions, superseding earlier requests to retain metric value and numeric checks here. The purpose is metric identity and exact attribute-key coverage, with separate key sets for successful and failed points, not aggregation or duplicate-recording coverage.

Keep all span assertions unchanged, including error.type="_OTHER" on the failed span and the direct StatusData.unset()/StatusData.error() assertions. Keep the response assertions unchanged. Do not change production code, the Boolean-response design, shared assertion helpers, other tests, documentation, the changelog, or other PRs or issues. Do not add new helpers, tests, or coverage matrices. Follow repository formatting instructions and run the narrow relevant existing test. Preserve this PR's draft state and base branch. Do not post replies to human comments, resolve threads, or request a review.

The removed `assertMetrics` call checked values and counts. Preserve those checks when splitting the histogram: assert exact attributes, including `error.type="_OTHER"` on the failed point, with 1 failed observation and 2 non-error observations (batch plus successful message).
